verdict.rationale: React's own docs say that on the server it can start streaming HTML while still fetching data, progressively filling in the remaining content before any JavaScript loads. This matches the story directly. It is backed by hydrateRoot attaching to HTML generated by react-dom/server and by the GitHub statement that React renders on the server via Node. Missing for 10: reference-level documentation of the streaming APIs and Suspense boundary behavior in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration of perceived-load gains.
